shots.model_position: 人物位于第二层空间的三分点，完整或四分之三身体可见，与前景形成深度关系
shots.photographer_position: 摄影师退到门框、植物、窗帘或人群后方，让前景占画面一侧 20–35%
shots.crop_boundary: 优先完整全身；若使用四分之三景别，只能在大腿中段或小腿中段裁切，不切膝、踝、肘、腕，前景不得遮脸和执行动作的手
shots.set_design: 前景必须是现场已有的门框、帘、植物或行人轮廓，中景给人物一个可执行动作，背景用光源或结构线收束；三层之间亮度或清晰度要有分离
shots.must_show: 前景占一侧 20–35%，人物位于第二空间层，背景仍可读，动作通过前景被观察，画面不是单平面
shots.reject_if: 把模糊叶子随便贴在镜头前、前景遮脸、背景空白、人物仍是正中半身、三层没有明暗或焦点差异
shots.lighting_setup: 自然侧光或傍晚前光，不过度补平阴影
shots.palette: 暖黄色、自然肤色和轻微颗粒
shots.composition_intent: WIDE environmental fashion shot through huge blurred foreground leaves covering 40 percent of frame, small off-center full body, deep layered space
shots.action_anchor: subject performs a location action observed through a real foreground layer
master_must_show: subject remains readable in middle plane
depth separation by focus or light
master_crop_boundary: foreground never covers face or action hand
full body preferred
if three-quarter crop, cut only mid-thigh or mid-calf
no cut at knee, ankle, wrist or elbow
master_reject_if: random fake blur pasted over lens
shots.generator_prompt: layered environmental fashion photograph through a real foreground doorway or leaves, off-center subject in middle plane, deep spatial staging. a believable real-world location. Preserve the subject and clothing specified in the scene brief. Photorealistic fashion editorial, natural anatomy, believable available light.
shots.negative_prompt: bikini, swimwear, lingerie, underwear, nudity, topless, revealing clothing, fake blur sticker, foreground covering face, centered headshot, flat single plane, empty background, deformed hands, extra fingers, duplicate person, warped limbs, bad face, plastic skin, watermark, text, logo
shots.execution_note: 先锁定真实场景、画框边界和机位，再让模特执行动作；不得用退回平视居中半身像的方式补数。

acceptance_gate.crop: pass only if crop_boundary is visibly satisfied
acceptance_gate.set: pass only if foreground, subject action, and background form one spatial event
acceptance_gate.camera: pass only if the requested camera language is recognizable without reading the label
